{bu,fg=accent}Fixing the pagination bug{/}

The test in {fg=code}./orders{/} fails because
{b,fg=code}List{/} computes the offset from a
{i}zero-based{/} page, but pages are
one-based: page 1 skips the first
{fg=code}size{/} rows. See {u,fg=info}the handler{/}
{fg=dim}(https://example.com/orders/list.go){/}
or {u,fg=info}https://example.com/docs{/}.

{b,fg=info}What changed{/}

{fg=dim}• {/}{fg=code}offset := page * size{/} became {fg=code}(page{/}
  {fg=code}- 1) * size{/}
{fg=dim}• {/}a guard for {fg=code}page < 1{/}:
  {fg=dim}1. {/}return an error
  {fg=dim}2. {/}or clamp to 1
{b,fg=good}[x] {/}test added
{fg=dim}[ ] {/}changelog entry

{i,fg=quote}▎ Note: pages stay one-based in the{/}
{i,fg=quote}▎ API. Only the SQL offset changes.{/}

{fg=faint,bg=slab}│ {/}{i,fg=dim,bg=slab}go{/}{bg=slab}                                {/}
{fg=faint,bg=slab}│ {/}{bg=slab}func (s *Store) List(ctx context.C{/}
{fg=faint,bg=slab}│ ↳{/}{bg=slab}ontext, page, size int) ([]Order,{/}
{fg=faint,bg=slab}│ ↳{/}{bg=slab} error) {                        {/}
{fg=faint,bg=slab}│ {/}{bg=slab}    offset := (page - 1) * size   {/}
{fg=faint,bg=slab}│ {/}{bg=slab}    return s.query(ctx, offset, si{/}
{fg=faint,bg=slab}│ ↳{/}{bg=slab}ze)                              {/}
{fg=faint,bg=slab}│ {/}{bg=slab}}                                 {/}
